summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $3.8 million PIPE financing with an angel investor and strategic gaming partner, plus an $800,000 content acquisition of 10 film/TV IPs via equity issuance, both on April 24, 2026. Net proceeds will fund AIGC platform development and general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transactions are operational capital raises and asset purchases, not a transformative M&A, tender, or activist campaign. While they involve equity issuance to investors, they do not meet the defined special-situation categories—they are routine capital and content acquisitions. Watch for execution of the AIGC strategy and potential dilution impact.
